items.passage: Transcript: Good afternoon, artists. This is Oriana Feldt from the campus gallery with an update on the spring student exhibition. In past years, you've dropped your work off at the gallery itself, on the ground floor of the Ostler Building. This year the gallery floor is being refinished, so please bring your pieces upstairs to Room 336, the print studio. Drop-off was announced for Monday afternoon, but the floor crew needs the building that whole day, so drop-off has moved to Wednesday. And because the studio has a printmaking class on Wednesday afternoons, drop-off will be that morning instead. Now, several of you have asked about wall labels. You won't be writing those yourselves. The jurors are judging the show without knowing whose work is whose, so no names go on the walls until judging finishes on Friday. Our student assistants will put the labels up then. If a piece won't fit through the studio door, call me at extension 2316.
items.prompt: [Announcement — Campus art gallery] Why does the speaker say, "You won't be writing those yourselves"?
choices: To indicate that the labels will be posted once judging ends
To indicate that the staff will print the labels in one style
To indicate that drop-off will take less time than before
To indicate that the jurors will add the artists' names
items.correct_answer: To indicate that the labels will be posted once judging ends
items.explanation: Right after the line the speaker says "The jurors are judging the show without knowing whose work is whose, so no names go on the walls until judging finishes on Friday. Our student assistants will put the labels up then." The line introduces the fact that labels go up only after judging. "To indicate that the staff will print the labels in one style" is a reading of the line alone; nothing is said about a style. "To indicate that drop-off will take less time than before" is also a reading of the line alone; the speaker never connects labels to the length of drop-off. "To indicate that the jurors will add the artists' names" is wrong because the jurors judge without names and the student assistants put the labels up.

items.explanation: The speaker says drop-off "has moved to Wednesday" and, "because the studio has a printmaking class on Wednesday afternoons, drop-off will be that morning instead." "On Monday afternoon" is the originally announced time that was cancelled because the floor crew needs the building that day.
